transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Business Card Services. My name is Julian. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Julian, my name is Monica Faraday. I'm the office manager at Faraday & Pell LLC, and I'm looking at our latest statement and there's a charge on here that shouldn't be there.
Agent: I can certainly look into that with you, Ms. Faraday. First, could you please confirm the business mailing address and the last four digits of the card?
Customer: Sure, the address is 410 North Oak Street, Suite 200, and the card ends in 7741.
Agent: Thank you for confirming that. Could you tell me the date and the amount of the transaction you're calling about?
Customer: Yes, our statement date is September 26, 2026, and the transaction is from Corvid Office Systems for $2,950.00.
Agent: All right, I see that here on the account. What date does it show for the transaction itself, and can you share what happened?
Customer: The charge date was September 16, 2026. It says it's for office equipment, but we never ordered anything from this company.
Agent: Have you spoken with anyone else at Faraday & Pell LLC to see if someone placed this order?
Customer: Yes, absolutely. Only two of us have access to the business account, myself and Mr. Pell, and neither of us ever bought anything or approved an order from them.
Agent: Did you happen to contact Corvid Office Systems about this?
Customer: I did call them earlier this week. They told me an order was placed under our business name for some kind of printing setup, but I told them we never asked for that and don't do business with them.
Agent: Did they offer to provide an invoice or explain how the order was submitted?
Customer: The representative on the phone said they would look into it and email me an invoice, but I haven't received anything from them since.
Agent: Understood. Did any packages or equipment actually arrive at your office location?
Customer: No, nothing has shown up at our office at all.
Agent: And is the physical card still in your possession?
Customer: Yes, I have the physical card right here with me in my wallet.
Agent: Okay, so just to make sure I have all the details noted correctly, you have a charge of $2,950.00 from Corvid Office Systems dated September 16, 2026, appearing on your September 26, 2026 statement, for equipment that nobody at your company ordered or received, and the card has remained in your possession.
